acceptance: Every failed cell of this job is named with its cause.
Each cause is fixed with a test, or the cell is pruned from the gate with proven external cause and a restoration item filed.
description:
## Problem
Scheduled trunk UAT run 45389336355 (develop ee2e196e3c, 2026-11-24) failed job `UAT stage 2 cedardb` (job 138429445576) in step "Run the stage shard against the trunk distribution". The failed cells were not readable while the run was in progress; read the job log (`[sweep] FAILED CELL` lines) and the shard artifact.

## Change
Name every failed cell and its first error with evidence; compare with the last green run of the shard. Fix a BenchBox cause with a regression test.

## Owner decision (choice dialog, 2026-11-24)
"Fix forward. If a cell's cause is proven to be outside BenchBox (engine bug, runner limit), prune that cell from the gate and file a restoration item, without asking. Never raise a budget or timeout."

## Guardrails
Heavy work only through make heavy-run; no live cloud. No retry, timeout or budget increase to turn the shard green.
